-- PostgreSQL permits infinity timestamps, but their derived age is not a Duration.
            INSERT INTO outbox_messages (
                id,
                message_id,
                message_type,
                message_version,
                content_type,
                payload,
                metadata,
                created_at,
                claimable_at,
                attempts
            )
            VALUES (
                uuidv7(),
                uuidv7(),
                'postgres.infinite-age',
                1,
                'application/test',
                ''::bytea,
                '{}'::jsonb,
                '-infinity',
                now(),
                0
            )
